art_direction: 斜生竹枝与一片飘落竹叶形成疏密对照，青灰水墨留白。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Draw one bamboo branch leaning diagonally across a pale mineral-gray paper field. Three joints and two small clusters of pointed leaves are enough to establish the plant. A single detached leaf falls toward the lower center, making the composition feel suspended. Use variable dry-brush pressure for the stem and denser wet ink for the leaves. Introduce only a diluted celadon wash behind the upper cluster. Preserve generous bare paper, avoiding a dense bamboo grove or ornamental border. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for clear original focal composition, requested medium and detail level, circular-crop readability, no unintended anatomy or rendering defects, no text or watermark
